g.text: Consent for three uses: default to the narrowest
ask for each use separately; never train on prompts without opt-in
a. improve the product for this user (narrowest, default)
b. evaluation and analytics (its own consent)
c. training or fine-tuning models (clear opt-in only)
rights to withdraw and to erasure
not collected by default: full customer PII (redact first)
each use needs its own consent and its own retention rule
support example: sent as is, edited (store the diff), or discarded
